children: China’s exports soared 25.0% year-on-year to USD 401.44 billion in August 2026, matching forecasts and accelerating from July’s 23.9% growth.
For the first eight months of the year, total exports increased 19.3% yoy to USD 2.92 trillion.

title: China Export Growth Matches Estimates
